description: This file provides utility routines for univariate root-finding solvers, including methods for solving functions, bracketing roots, and verifying intervals and signs. It defines the class `UnivariateSolverUtils`, which offers static helper methods to facilitate root-solving algorithms in the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: UnivariateSolverUtils
classes.description: Utility routines for root finding of univariate functions, including solving, bracketing, and verification methods.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of a univariate function within a given interval using a default solver.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of a univariate function within a given interval using a specified absolute accuracy.

methods.name: forceSide
methods.description: Adjusts a root found by a non-bracketing solver to lie on a specified side within given bounds.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Attempts to find two values that bracket a root, expanding from an initial estimate.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Overloaded method with maximum iteration parameter, attempts to bracket a root.

methods.name: midpoint
methods.description: Computes the midpoint between two values.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks if the function values at two points have opposite signs, indicating a root is bracketed.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Verifies if three numbers form a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Checks that the interval bounds are valid (lower < upper).

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Ensures that the bounds form a valid increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Validates that the function values at two points bracket a root.
